Pukaar · Rescuer dashboard

D1 to D5 in dark, D2 and D3 in light, the core flow, all states and the component sheet. Sample data is from a flood in Darbhanga district. Attended uses primary indigo (your pick), so amber stays for warnings like low battery and stale location.

1D2 Live operations · D3 SOS detail (dark)The map holds most of the screen. The list on the right is sorted by priority: new before attended, then more people, then injured or trapped, then low battery, then oldest. The status counts in the top bar double as the status filter. Resolved is off by default.

Arrival. The pin fades in with two ripple rings that pulse twice and then settle into a static halo. The row slides into its priority slot (3rd) with a soft red tint that fades over 60 s, and its time reads “Just now” in SOS colour. The New count ticks from 12 to 13. A short chime plays once (sound is on by default, toggle in the top bar). The toast sits bottom-left over the map for 8 s and never covers the list. No modal.
